prompt: Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Use Spectrum 2-2: page #FBF9FA, text #2D1F25, accent #864E1D, secondary surface #E9EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 20px, heading 64px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
